purpose: The gap-8 requirement: four fresh targets through #148's full checklist. This records what was prepared and why the selection itself was not performed.
argv:
import collections, json
r = json.load(open('targets/reservations.json'))
confidence = collections.Counter(v['confidence'] for v in r['reserved'].values())
print('reservation set derived by rule: %d pull requests from %d inventory rows'
      % (r['reserved_count'], r['inventory_rows_read']))
print('evidence: %d strong, %d conservative' % (confidence['strong'], confidence['conservative']))
print('sources digested:', len(r['sources_sha256']))
e = json.load(open('targets/eligibility-machinery-check.json'))
print('mechanical criteria exercised on %d candidates; selected targets: 0'
      % len(e['candidates']))
